provisional_boundary.approval_required: Reconcile against the missing boundary screenshot before any production bake.

authoritative_source.policy: Preserve all original geographic arrays, rasters, metadata and generated gameplay sources. This manifest does not crop, move, resample or delete source data.

include_whole_system: Deep River town buildings and details
roads, walkways, traffic controls and street furniture
near and far water needed by the region
town detail, silhouette and stem vegetation
gameplay collision and navigation required by included locations
local NPC, quest, vehicle, boating and weather integration points
external_proxy_only: terrain and forest wholly outside the provisional boundary
ownership.boundary_policy: Keep crossing tiles/cells intact for the first bake. Splitting is a later measured optimization, never an implicit destructive crop.

runtime_policy.intended_first_use: offline deterministic region bake and validation only

acceptance_checks: Original source data hashes remain unchanged.
Every included gameplay landmark retains its original world coordinates.
Crossing geometry remains whole until a separately reviewed split operation exists.
The current monolithic game remains the default launch path.
A generated region must be reproducible from source and disposable without data loss.
